notes: Decides I-057 track A. demonized_ledge_grabbing was 68.2 us/frame in the gen4-all arm of the exploratory moving run (20260920-110221-I-053-5895a5); this variant gates that listener so the 15-ray scan runs only when the climb keybind actually reads its result. Listener-mode profiler so the ledge row can be read directly: expect demonized_ledge_grabbing to go from ~68 to under 1 us/frame and nothing else to move except the track-B riders (fluid_aim, actor_effects, battery_warning, light_gem_mcm, together ~3-11 us). If the ledge row does not collapse, the gate is not firing and the patch is wrong.
